经过: 喀喇汗王朝取布哈拉，萨曼亡。
text_en: The Kara-Khanids take Bukhara, and the Samanids fall.

经过: 喀喇汗王朝攻灭于阗。
text_en: The Kara-Khanids conquer Khotan.

经过: 甘州回鹘攻入凉州，六谷部溃散，余部投唃厮啰（一说 1015）。
title_en: Fall of the Six Valleys tribes
text_en: The Ganzhou Uyghurs break into Liangzhou and the Six Valleys confederacy scatters; the remnants join Gusiluo (one account says 1015).

经过: 伽色尼马哈茂德并花剌子模（马蒙王朝亡）。
text_en: Mahmud of Ghazni annexes Khwarazm, ending the Ma'munids.

经过: 拜占庭巴西尔二世灭第一保加利亚帝国。
title_en: Fall of the First Bulgarian Empire
text_en: Basil II of Byzantium destroys the First Bulgarian Empire.

经过: 李元昊破甘州，甘州回鹘亡。
text_en: Li Yuanhao takes Ganzhou, and the Ganzhou Uyghurs fall.

经过: 西夏取沙州，归义军亡。
text_en: Western Xia takes Shazhou, and the Guiyi Jun falls.

标题: 巴格拉提德亚美尼亚亡
经过: 拜占庭吞并阿尼，巴格拉提德亚美尼亚亡。
text_en: Byzantium annexes Ani, and Bagratid Armenia falls.

经过: 塞尔柱入巴格达（1055），法尔斯的布韦希余部 1062 年亡。
text_en: The Seljuks enter Baghdad (1055), and the last Buyids in Fars fall in 1062.

经过: 塞尔柱马立克沙取撒马尔罕，西喀喇汗为其藩属。
title_en: The Western Kara-Khanids become Seljuk vassals
text_en: Malik-Shah takes Samarkand, and the Western Kara-Khanids become Seljuk vassals.

经过: 拜占庭与库曼联军于勒乌尼昂歼灭佩切涅格。
text_en: Byzantium and the Cumans annihilate the Pechenegs at Levounion.

经过: 宋取青唐、湟州，唃厮啰政权亡（1099 年初取，1104 年再定）。
text_en: Song takes Qingtang and Huangzhou, and the Gusiluo regime falls (first taken in 1099, finally secured in 1104).

经过: 金取燕京，北辽亡。
text_en: Jin takes Yanjing, and the Northern Liao falls.

经过: 天祚帝被金兵俘获，辽亡（耶律大石西走建西辽）。
text_en: Emperor Tianzuo is captured by the Jin, and Liao falls (Yelü Dashi goes west and founds the Western Liao).

经过: 高昌回鹘臣服西辽。
title_en: Qocho becomes a Western Liao vassal
text_en: The Uyghurs of Qocho submit to the Western Liao.

经过: 耶律大石取八剌沙衮，东喀喇汗降为藩属。
title_en: The Eastern Kara-Khanids become Western Liao vassals
text_en: Yelü Dashi takes Balasagun, and the Eastern Kara-Khanids become his vassals.

经过: 金废刘豫，伪齐亡。
text_en: Jin deposes Liu Yu, and the puppet state of Qi ends.

经过: 桑贾尔死，大塞尔柱帝国瓦解。
title_en: Breakup of the Great Seljuk Empire
text_en: Sanjar dies and the Great Seljuk Empire falls apart.

经过: 萨拉丁废法蒂玛哈里发，法蒂玛亡。
text_en: Saladin abolishes the Fatimid Caliphate.

经过: 罗姆苏丹国并达尼什曼德。
text_en: The Sultanate of Rum annexes the Danishmendid lands.

经过: 古尔王朝攻陷拉合尔，伽色尼亡。
text_en: The Ghurids take Lahore, and the Ghaznavids fall.

经过: 乌古斯部众占据克尔曼，克尔曼塞尔柱亡。
title_en: Fall of the Seljuks of Kerman
text_en: Oghuz bands seize Kerman, and the Seljuks of Kerman fall.

经过: 花剌子模杀图格里勒三世，伊拉克塞尔柱亡。
title_en: Fall of the Seljuks of Iraq
text_en: Khwarazm kills Toghrul III, and the Seljuks of Iraq fall.

经过: 铁木真灭塔塔儿。
text_en: Temüjin destroys the Tatars.

经过: 铁木真袭破克烈，王罕败死。
text_en: Temüjin surprises the Keraites, and Ong Khan dies in defeat.

经过: 弘吉剌部归附铁木真。
text_en: The Khongirad submit to Temüjin.

经过: 纳忽山之战，太阳汗战死，乃蛮亡。
text_en: At the battle of Naqu Mountain Tayang Khan is killed, and the Naimans fall.

经过: 铁木真破蔑儿乞（余部 1218 年亡）。
text_en: Temüjin defeats the Merkits (the last of them are destroyed in 1218).

经过: 术赤北征，吉利吉思降。
text_en: Jochi campaigns north and the Kyrgyz submit.

经过: 斡亦剌部降蒙古（一说 1207）。
text_en: The Oirats submit to the Mongols (one account says 1207).

经过: 哲别追斩屈出律，西辽亡。
text_en: Jebe hunts down and kills Kuchlug, and the Western Liao falls.

经过: 札兰丁取大不里士，埃尔迪居兹亡。
text_en: Jalal al-Din takes Tabriz, and the Eldiguzids fall.

经过: 夏末帝出降被杀，西夏亡。
text_en: The last Xia emperor surrenders and is killed; Western Xia falls.

经过: 札兰丁为蒙古所逐，死于库尔德人之手，花剌子模亡。
text_en: Driven out by the Mongols, Jalal al-Din is killed by Kurds, and Khwarazm falls.

经过: 蒙古擒蒲鲜万奴，东夏亡。
text_en: The Mongols capture Puxian Wannu, and Eastern Xia falls.

经过: 蔡州城破，金哀宗自缢，金亡。
text_en: Caizhou is stormed and Emperor Aizong of Jin hangs himself; Jin falls.

经过: 拔都西征灭伏尔加保加尔。
text_en: Batu's western campaign destroys Volga Bulgaria.

经过: 蒙哥擒八赤蛮，钦察诸部破（一部西走匈牙利）。
text_en: Möngke captures Bachman and the Kipchak tribes are broken (some flee west to Hungary).

经过: 蒙古克麦怯思。
text_en: The Mongols take Maghas.

经过: 拔都攻陷基辅。
text_en: Batu storms Kiev.

经过: 1236 年蒙古占东格鲁吉亚，女王鲁苏丹出奔库塔伊西；1243 年称臣。
text_en: In 1236 the Mongols occupy eastern Georgia and Queen Rusudan flees to Kutaisi; in 1243 Georgia submits.

经过: 克塞山之战败，罗姆苏丹国臣服蒙古。
text_en: Defeated at Köse Dağ, the Sultanate of Rum submits to the Mongols.

经过: 克塞山之战后特拉比松向蒙古称臣。
text_en: After Köse Dağ Trebizond submits to the Mongols.

经过: 海屯一世归附蒙古（1247 年订立藩属约）。
title_en: Cilician Armenia becomes a Mongol vassal
text_en: Hethum I submits to the Mongols (a formal vassal treaty follows in 1247).

经过: 萨迦班智达与阔端凉州会盟，乌思藏归附蒙古。
text_en: Sakya Pandita meets Köten at Liangzhou, and Ü-Tsang submits to the Mongols.

经过: 忽必烈克大理（1253），段兴智被擒（1254），大理亡。
text_en: Kublai takes Dali (1253) and Duan Xingzhi is captured (1254); Dali falls.

经过: 旭烈兀破巴格达，杀哈里发穆斯台绥木。
text_en: Hülegü sacks Baghdad and kills the caliph al-Musta'sim.

经过: 高丽太子入朝请降。
text_en: The Goryeo crown prince comes to the Mongol court to submit.

经过: 旭烈兀取阿勒颇、大马士革，阿尤布亡（埃及部分 1250 年已为马穆鲁克所代）。
text_en: Hülegü takes Aleppo and Damascus, and the Ayyubids fall (in Egypt the Mamluks had replaced them in 1250).

经过: 阿里不哥降忽必烈。
text_en: Ariq Böke surrenders to Kublai.

经过: 崖山海战，陆秀夫负帝昺投海，宋亡。
text_en: At the naval battle of Yamen Lu Xiufu leaps into the sea with the boy emperor Bing, and Song falls.
